sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: REVERSAL: The retrieved canonical metadata authoritatively assigns fractureMargin, majorBucklingMargin, and yieldingMargin to the ship owner, so reverse the earlier case-owner instruction for these operand terms and check all six quantity operands on the targeted ship, not on calculationCase. Preserve calculationCase ownership for calculationMethod, nonlinearAnalysisAcceptanceEvidence, and minorPermanentDeformationAssessmentSatisfied. Also replace qudt:UNITLESS and qudt:MilliM, which expand to the schema namespace, with the canonical unit IRIs http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/UNITLESS and http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/MilliM. Retain the nonlinear calculationMethod applicability guard and the readiness evidence/result checks.
